evaluation.rationale: The notes capture almost every detail from the transcript, resulting in high retention scores. However, they suffer from severe structural and logical flaws. The notes are extremely repetitive, duplicating sections (e.g., 'Action items' and 'Action items (structured)'). More critically, they report superseded values as final decisions and action items alongside the actual final decisions, creating direct contradictions (e.g., stating both Priya and Dan are booking the cabin, and both Oct 16-19 and Oct 23-26 are the dates). They also list resolved issues as open questions. Furthermore, the notes include numerous irrelevant distractors.
